references.text: God repeatedly demands that Pharaoh let the people go, and Pharaoh's refusal shows his pride against God.
Moses asks Pharaoh how long he will refuse to humble himself before the Lord, addressing the same theme of pride and exalting oneself against God.
Pride comes before a fall, and arrogance before destruction - describing the consequence of exalting oneself as Pharaoh did.
A person's pride leads to humiliation - Pharaoh's exaltation against God led to his humbling.
Describes arrogance and the desire to exalt oneself, similar to Pharaoh's attitude toward God and His people.
God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble - Pharaoh represents the proud one whom God resists.
Direct continuation of the same prophetic warning and sequence of events.
